name: Brand library
author: Brett
description: Browse the framework's brand library: 250 logos, 250 animated logos, 100 icon packs and 50 branding packages for AmberX and GizmoX, in tabs with search, brand and style filters and a virtualised grid. Preview any piece light and dark at every size (animations play), copy its id, and apply it: a branding package becomes the brand, a logo, animated logo or icon pack goes into the active brand. Nav → Plugins → Brand library; settings in Settings → Plugins → Brand library.
